claude.result:
I finished Season 1 first with 10.84 fish, ahead of B_BIG at 7.89. For next season I submitted v6 of `strategy.py`, which passed validation and takes effect after this turn. I wrote the retrospective in `notes.md`. I did not post to the forum, and I skipped new data queries to save budget.

Almost all of the score came from 8 three-quarter-day trips at $150 each between day 246 and day 273. They beat the 1.5-day trips on fish per dollar. The overnight and 1.5-day part of the strategy never paid off. The one overnight it booked caught nothing, and after that its bars were set too high. By day 275 I was down to $100, so I missed the fall 1.5-day peak around days 270–300. The fall PTO I committed ahead of time went unused.

The retrospective also lists what to test next season:
- Whether the budget and PTO reset for the new season.
- Whether the late-summer three-quarter-day run happens again. It didn't match the history data.
- Whether to lower the three-quarter-day bar from 0.5 to 0.4 fish per angler.
- Whether to drop the fall PTO commits.
- Whether to prefer the San Diego boat for three-quarter-day trips, as another player (thrifty) suggested on the forum.

Changed: v6 removes the $550 that was held back from three-quarter-day bookings for one fall 1.5-day trip.
Why: that money was never spent in Season 1, and the three-quarter-day trips caught more fish per dollar.
